{
  "candidate": "cand_0001",
  "headline": "Six scorer-grounded prompt fixes: verify-checklist, openpyxl-in-place, code-fence example, typed dates, no-sheet=first-sheet, stable sort.",
  "clusters": [
    {"id": "A", "name": "Cosmetic verify + identical resubmits",
     "detail": "Agent reprints output but never checks completeness/type/baseline, and re-sends byte-identical solution code, wasting rounds.",
     "tasks": ["47766", "52216", "250-20", "493-18", "54638"],
     "scope": "WIDESPREAD", "latent": false, "tag": "BEHAVIORAL"},
    {"id": "B", "name": "pandas full-sheet round-trip corrupts file",
     "detail": "pd.read_excel then df.to_excel injects Unnamed:N into blank headers, coerces text IDs to numbers, and drops/shifts cells and other sheets.",
     "tasks": ["493-18", "250-20", "262-17"],
     "scope": "WIDESPREAD", "latent": false, "tag": "CAPABILITY-GAP"},
    {"id": "C", "name": "Malformed code fence, no execution",
     "detail": "Model emitted a <|tool_call|> wrapper instead of a ```python fence; nothing ran and output_path was never written.",
     "tasks": ["48365"], "scope": "BOUNDED", "latent": true, "tag": "KNOWLEDGE"},
    {"id": "D", "name": "Date/time written as a string",
     "detail": "strftime produced a text time; grader compares a real time trimmed to HH:MM, so the literal string never matches.",
     "tasks": ["32438"], "scope": "BOUNDED", "latent": false, "tag": "KNOWLEDGE"},
    {"id": "E", "name": "Wrong sheet when answer_position has no sheet qualifier",
     "detail": "Agent wrote to Sheet2 but a no-! range is graded on the first sheet (sheetnames[0]).",
     "tasks": ["54638"], "scope": "BOUNDED", "latent": false, "tag": "KNOWLEDGE"},
    {"id": "F", "name": "Unstable sort reorders ties",
     "detail": "pandas default quicksort reorders rows equal on the sort key; Excel sorts are stable.",
     "tasks": ["262-17"], "scope": "BOUNDED", "latent": false, "tag": "KNOWLEDGE"}
  ],
  "edits": [
    {"id": "E1", "title": "Verification becomes an ordered precondition checklist (value+type, no empty/default cells, baseline/extent sanity, no identical resubmit)",
     "files": ["task_template.md"], "lever": "BEHAVIORAL", "clusters": ["A"],
     "blast_radius": "BOUNDED", "verified": "Passing 32902/48745 already verify and leave no empty cells, so they still finish after a passing check; failing 47766/52216/250-20/493-18/54638 each tripped exactly one listed check."},
    {"id": "E2", "title": "Edit in place with openpyxl; do not round-trip a whole sheet via pandas; if pandas, use header=None/header=False and dtype=str for ID columns",
     "files": ["prompt.md"], "lever": "CAPABILITY-GAP", "clusters": ["B"],
     "blast_radius": "BOUNDED", "verified": "Explicitly endorses 48745's header=None/header=False path and 32902's in-place path; removes the Unnamed:N and dtype damage seen in 493-18/250-20."},
    {"id": "E3", "title": "Worked ```python fence example + ban on tool_call/XML/call wrappers + recovery instruction",
     "files": ["task_template.md"], "lever": "CONTRACT", "clusters": ["C"],
     "blast_radius": "BOUNDED", "verified": "48365's logic was correct but never fenced; passing traces already fence correctly so are only reinforced."},
    {"id": "E4", "title": "Write dates/times as real datetime/time values, never strftime/str/TEXT",
     "files": ["prompt.md"], "lever": "KNOWLEDGE", "clusters": ["D"],
     "blast_radius": "BOUNDED", "verified": "Scorer trims a real time to HH:MM; 32438's string fails. Scoped to dates/times, so 48745 (text labels) and 32902 (numbers) are untouched."},
    {"id": "E5", "title": "No sheet name in answer_position => first sheet; named sheet => that exact sheet",
     "files": ["prompt.md"], "lever": "KNOWLEDGE", "clusters": ["E"],
     "blast_radius": "BOUNDED", "verified": "Matches grader sheetnames[0] default; 32902/48745 already target the first/only sheet."},
    {"id": "E6", "title": "Use a stable sort (kind='mergesort') so tied rows keep original order",
     "files": ["prompt.md"], "lever": "KNOWLEDGE", "clusters": ["F"],
     "blast_radius": "BOUNDED", "verified": "262-17 fails only on the copy whose tie block quicksort reorders; no passing task sorts."}
  ],
  "skipped": [
    {"title": "Prose workaround for an environment fault", "reason": "No environment fault found; 48365 is a fixable model output-format quirk, not infra."},
    {"title": "Hardcoding 250-20's dedup criterion", "reason": "Would overfit one task; nudged via the verify row-count check instead."},
    {"title": "Blanket 'numbers must not be strings' rule", "reason": "Scorer coerces numeric strings to float, so number-as-text already matches; such a rule wastes words and risks over-coercion that would regress 48745's text output."}
  ],
  "techniques": ["parallel read-only diagnostic subagents", "read scorer source to ground the output contract", "ordered precondition checklist", "worked example", "sourced knowledge rules", "scoped additive edits to protect passing tasks"]
}
